title: Mileage Rate Bulletin — RideLink Rates for Wheelchair Users and Treatment Trips
content:
Mileage reimbursed under Non-Emergency Medical Transportation is paid at a higher per-mile rate for members who use a wheelchair or who drive to certain treatments.

**Rule.** The per-mile rate follows the member's equipment and the trip's purpose: when the member holds an approved or expired Durable Medical Equipment Authorization for a standard manual wheelchair, service code K0001, and the outbound leg's trip purpose is radiation, chemotherapy or dialysis, every approved mile is paid the treatment chair rate of 0.32 USD; when exactly one of those two holds, every approved mile is paid the chair or treatment rate of 0.26 USD; when neither holds, every approved mile is paid the level's standard mileage rate.

The wheelchair authorization is read from the member's Prior Authorization records — the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization class, service code K0001, in approved or expired status. The trip purpose is the one registered on the trip's outbound leg.

## Rate matrix

| K0001 wheelchair authorization approved or expired | Outbound purpose radiation, chemotherapy or dialysis | Rate per approved mile |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.32 USD |
| Yes | No | 0.26 USD |
| No | Yes | 0.26 USD |
| No | No | Level's standard mileage rate |

## Cases

*Hypothetical members:*

- Expired K0001 wheelchair authorization, driving to dialysis: 0.32 USD a mile.
- Approved K0001 wheelchair authorization, driving to a behavioral health appointment: 0.26 USD a mile.
- No wheelchair authorization, driving to chemotherapy: 0.26 USD a mile.
- A K0001 authorization in denied status, driving to a routine medical appointment: the level's standard mileage rate.

The rate applies to every approved mile of the trip.
